BiblicalUsage: Zephathah is the valley where Asa faced the Ethiopian army under Zerah. In 2 Chronicles 14:10, they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that a place like Zephathah is worth knowing because God's story unfolded there.
